light.* shows the status reported by the: light.* shows the status reported by the gateway. The state light.zone selects the zone the commands of light.* are sent to (0 = all zones, 1–8 = one zone). Recommended, because every state shows what the gateway reports.

light.* shows the status reported by the gateway and sends its commands to all zones. In addition, the channels zones.zone1 … zones.zone8 control each zone separately. The gateway does not report a status per zone: a zone channel shows the last values sent to this zone and confirmed by the gateway.
The gateway reports only one status for: The gateway reports only one status for all lamps: the last setting, whichever zone it was sent to. When this setting is changed, the states of the other variant are deleted.
Tuya devices usually accept only one loc: Tuya devices usually accept only one local connection. If the connection keeps failing, close the MiBoxer app on phones in the same network and do not control the gateway with other local integrations at the same time.
